item.name: Force Staff

effects.title: Force
effects.text: Pushes any target unit 600 units in the direction it is facing.

notes: Self-cast will cause you to use Force on yourself.
Force Staff doesn't interrupt the target's actions.
Will not work on a unit inside Chronosphere, Duel, or Black Hole.
Force Staff has 850 cast range when cast on enemies.
item.lore: Allows you to manipulate others, for good or evil.
